rationale: The agent submitted an exchange without first authenticating the user or confirming the order-changing action. There is no evidence of identity verification (e.g., find_user_id_by_name_zip) or confirmation before performing the write (exchange_delivered_order_items). The agent stated the exchange was already submitted and that a charge would be applied to a specific card, which violates the policy requirement to confirm before any order-changing write. While the item preferences and price difference were addressed, the lack of authentication and pre-write confirmation means the outcome does not meet the policy pass bar.
